title: Almost perfect!
body:
I previously had been using the stock iOS reminders as my To-Do list for the past few years and have decided to jump ship after they remove the ability to set the reminder timing from the desktop.

Best move I’ve ever made, I think the ability to access, create and update all my tasks on both my phone (iOS) and my computer (windows) makes keeping track of my stuff so easy and seamless!

Why you’re lacking the 5th star?

1st.The snooze function for reminders. 
If you hit a snooze for a reminder regardless of what device or platform your using, it’s 2 minute snooze and it’s barely sufficient time for me to complete my current task that i’m occupied with to go to the one that’s now being brought up. And if it becomes annoying to hit snooze repeatedly every 2minutes.
Suggestion: increase the snooze duration to 5minutes or 10minutes. Or allow users to set a custom/preferred snooze duration from a pre-set selection in their settings. Some people may appreciate and find the current short snooze perfect, but there may be other users who would a longer snooze too.

2nd. Being allowed to set our own custom reminder timings for the “default” or quick reminder timings when creating a task. The default 9am for mornings is a tad annoying for me as I’d like to set it at 8am for everyday. That’s the time I would start my day and I believe many users too would have a particular timing they would need most of their task reminders which don’t happen to be at 9am. 
The ability to customize these aspects of reminders would make the app even better then what it is now!

These aren’t completely new functions, but rather adjustments to what is already available and in the app and giving users more control and even more seamless and quick use of it.

Takes a long time to load, can't scroll smoothly, almost makes me feel I'm using a device that's 10 years old instead of just 3 years old. I have more than 50 apps on my phone, including intensive messaging apps and photo and video editing apps, and not a single one has the same problem as Microsoft Outlook and Todo.
